rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that is growing or developing rapidly.

example.english: This little shop has been burgeoning lately, and business is so good we need to hire two more people.
example.traditional: 呢間細舖近排發展得好快，生意旺到要請多兩個人。
